_about: Scenarios for memcheck.py run. Each names its battery save ('sav', a file in --saves, default work/build/memcheck/, gitignored). Scripts use emu_smoke.py commands plus 'boot' (title -> Continue -> field; its A presses also talk to whatever the player faces). The field menu opens with X and its cursor starts on POKeDEX; left column POKeDEX, POKeMON, BAG, POKeGEAR; right column trainer card, SAVE, OPTIONS. Saves: route1_path_2mons.sav (Route 1 sand path away from tall grass, since wild Pokemon walk only in grass; Charmander + Caterpie), protographer.sav (Pallet Town, facing the photographer), trainer.sav (Route 1, facing an unbeaten trainer), market.sav (Poke Mart, facing the clerk), route1_townmap.sav (route1_path_2mons.sav plus the Town Map, item 442, in the key items), full_bag_6mons.sav (market.sav with every bag pocket filled and 6 Pokemon with 10-letter nicknames, 4 long moves and held items; built by writing the save data in RAM, see work/notes/heap_audit.md). 'shot' names end up in --out as <scenario>_<zh|en>_<name>.png: check them when a scenario or a save changes. trainer_2mons.sav is an isolated trainer checkpoint with the valid two-Pokemon party copied from route1_path_2mons in emulator RAM and saved normally; original saves are unchanged.
